items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Can you tell me just what Catello taught you? ... And you went there for a lesson. to see clarinet

ctx.x: Do you remember the other fellows? There were any of them?

I can't recall the piano player now. How I got to play it, Pete Lawless was through larynge. He was sick. They wanted somebody, because I guess I was taking lessons from his father. I couldn't play near as good as he could. Because he had the C clarinet and he played all the melody. And I didn't, never learn to play strictly melody. Yeah. Can you tell me just what Catello taught you? That is, what kind of a book, can you remember what kind of a book you had? What kind of exercises or what he made you do? And you…
